title: RadOncGym: An Agent-Based Framework for Radiotherapy Dose-Mimicking Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.33821v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI dose-prediction models generate patient-specific 3D dose distributions from patient anatomy, providing an important intermediate representation for automated radiotherapy planning. However, an AI-predicted dose must undergo downstream optimization to produce a physically constrained treatment plan, a process that requires balancing competing planning objectives. We present RadOncGym, an agent-based framework that enables an LLM agent to iteratively tune 12 planning-objective weights for dose-mimicking optimization. To reduce iterative evaluation cost, RadOncGym incorporates a surrogate verifier that provides rapid feedback while allowing the agent to decide when to request a full planning solve within a fixed solve budget. We evaluate RadOncGym on 60 OpenKBP head-and-neck patients, each paired with 10 predictions from OpenKBP-Opt dose-prediction sets, yielding 600 patient-prediction contexts per experimental configuration. translated_title: RadOncGym：一个用于放射治疗剂量模拟优化的基于智能体的框架
translated_abstract: AI剂量预测模型能够根据患者解剖结构生成患者特异性的三维剂量分布，为自动化放射治疗计划提供了重要的中间表示。然而，AI预测的剂量必须经过下游优化才能转化为符合物理约束的治疗计划，这一过程需要平衡相互竞争的规划目标。我们提出了RadOncGym，这是一个基于智能体的框架，使LLM智能体能够迭代调整12个规划目标权重以进行剂量模拟优化。为了降低迭代评估成本，RadOncGym引入了一个代理验证器（surrogate verifier），可提供快速反馈，同时允许智能体在固定的求解预算内自行决定何时请求完整的规划求解。我们在60名OpenKBP头颈部患者上评估了RadOncGym，每位患者与来自OpenKBP-Opt剂量预测集的10个预测结果配对，每个实验配置产生600个患者-预测上下文。
tldr: RadOncGym是一个基于智能体的框架，让LLM智能体在代理验证器的快速反馈辅助下迭代调整放射治疗剂量模拟优化的12个规划目标权重，从而将AI预测剂量转化为符合物理约束的治疗计划。
en_tdlr: RadOncGym is an agent-based framework that enables an LLM agent to iteratively tune 12 planning-objective weights for radiotherapy dose-mimicking optimization, aided by a surrogate verifier providing rapid feedback within a fixed solve budget.
